page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between compute and memory capabilities. Single-core processing tasks, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and single-threaded gzip compression, fall into the lower performance tier. However, multi-core operations and memory-bound tasks perform at average levels. The instance achieves average ratings in memory bandwidth tests, with read-only cached small blocks reaching 389.93 GB/sec and uncached large blocks reaching 49.43 GB/sec. Database operations, Redis SET operations at 6.84 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput at 6.52 GB/sec also demonstrate steady, mid-tier performance.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.r6.2xlarge is its moderate single-core CPU performance relative to its high memory capacity. This makes it a cost-efficient option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require top-tier raw compute speeds. It is appropriate for database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, software compilation, and static web serving.
